export.title: Data access request
export.subtitle: Access under Art. 15 and 20 GDPR as a JSON file. Your organisation remains the controller; this tool produces the file for it.

contents.title: File contents
contents.patient: Master data, all visits with the caregiver who performed them, and the access history for this patient.
contents.caregiver: Master data and account, contracts, working hours, absences, GPS consents and positions, visits, messages, routes and access history.
contents.excluded: Not included: password hash, MFA secret and sessions – credentials with no informational value. For a caregiver, also the identity of the patients visited: that is their data, not the caregiver's. The file states its own omissions.

export.done: File created. The download has started.
export.error: The access file could not be generated.

erasure.title: Erasure request
erasure.subtitle: Erasure under Art. 17 GDPR. Every operation is logged.

warning.title: Irreversible
warning.body: Anonymisation cannot be undone. Name and address are gone for good afterwards. Generate the access file first if the data subject has requested it.

effect.title: What happens
effect.patient: While the retention period for care documentation runs (§ 630f BGB), the record is only RESTRICTED: nothing is deleted, and it disappears from planning, alerts and route optimisation. Anonymisation follows only once the period has expired. The report states the date.
effect.caregiver: Name and account are anonymised; GPS positions, consents and sessions are deleted. Visits, contracts and working hours remain – they carry their own retention obligations.
